cell_metadata.cell_id: Unique identifier: FOV ID followed by -Cell and the segmentation label; join key for marker expression
cell_metadata.TLS: Figure 2L TLS identifier, TLS1 through TLS7
cell_metadata.fov: Figure TLS ID followed by the sampled section index
cell_metadata.label: Segmentation label within the original FOV
cell_metadata.centroid_y: FOV-local vertical pixel coordinate, increasing downwards
cell_metadata.cell_type: Final cell annotation used to calculate the serial TLS composition
cell_metadata.in_tls: True for cells belonging to the annotated TLS cell set; other FOV cells are excluded from TLS composition

marker_expression.values: Arcsinh-transformed cell marker expression as stored in the source X matrix

TLS_composition.units: Fraction of TLS member cells, from 0 to 1
TLS_composition.denominator: All cells with in_tls=True, including CD3T
TLS_composition.classifier_input: Percentage, from 0 to 100; B combines B, B-CD21, B-GC and PC; Bile_Duct maps to Cholangiocyte_like
TLS_composition.CD3T: Included in the denominator, with no separate classifier feature

classifier.training_validation: Leave one slide out; scaling and fitting performed on the training slides within each fold

fluorescence_images.intensity: Native QPTIFF channel values exported at downsample 1, stored as losslessly compressed uint8 TIFF
fluorescence_images.coordinates: region.json gives the FOV bounding rectangle in full-slide pixels and pixel calibration
fluorescence_images.maturation_labels: Figure 2M annotations, supplied for the four displayed sections
fluorescence_images.display_scope: Full FOVs with common channel limits; manuscript crop and display settings are not available
